title: Night queue: studies that run while the laptop is left alone
claude_budget_note: Claude Code calls one night may use (14 Nov, first guess: rules-author ~110 + study-15a ~500 + room for study-10's strong cells). Each job's claude_calls is a rough estimate for one night; the morning report shows the real count, so tune both from there.
paused_note: 14 Nov 2026: Carlo paused every experiment (only The Motion goes on, and it does not run from this queue). Every job is off; state.json keeps what each one finished, so setting a job's "enabled" back to true resumes it. The night then writes "Coda in pausa" in the morning report and stops.

jobs.name: study15-phase0-qwen-2
jobs.note: Study 15 phase 0, second run (Carlo OK 13 Nov 19:46): tolerant answer parsing, 2048 tokens, new claim task (partner states clues: true / false nobody could notice / false that clashes with one's own). Qwen3-8B, 200 puzzles, Modal L40S, stops by itself, ~$1-2 (at most ~$6). Run 1 was by hand on 13 Nov. Outcome in night-reports study15/latest.md. A new run needs a new name.

jobs.name: rules-author
jobs.note: Who wrote the rules? (The Trap): Gemini words the rules, then 3 episodes per rulebook with Claude, Gemini, Codex, and Claude + Codex judge the puzzles blind (~£1-2 Gemini, 2-3 h; Carlo OK 13 Nov). Picks up where it stopped (Gemini's rules already written 14 Nov). Moved before study-15a (coordinator, 14 Nov): it is smaller (~110 Claude calls) and sure to finish, while 15a would use up the limit; on 14 Nov it started at 01:36 after the organise/kata reruns and Claude had hit its 5-hour limit; outcome in night-reports rules-author/latest.md

jobs.name: study-10
jobs.note: Swarm, full run (study 10, local, £0; solo-strong uses Claude on the subscription). ~8k calls over several nights, keeps finished cells; repeats of a model Ollama lacks are skipped (pull gemma3:12b). Stops with exit 3 after 4 failed calls in a row (model not answering), and cells with more than 5% failed calls run again. Last in the queue: it fills whatever is left of the night (~10 nights at ~35 s a call), so the short jobs before it run first
